events.text: Standing rule at Coral Bay Scuba Adventures: any supplier order over 800 needs sign-off from our finance lead Priya Nair before it is placed.
Standing rule: once a client group booking is confirmed, we do not change the diver count without the group leader's written consent. Email them and wait for their yes.
Confirming our rates for Coral Bay Scuba Adventures: rental tanks are 9 per tank per day, delivered to the Coral Bay Marina fuel dock the evening before your trip. Order through me, Luis Ferrer.
Hi Marta, I am the group leader for Blue Reef Diving Club bookings at your centre. Anything about our club trips comes through me, Dana Ruiz.
For the season: my boat Marlin II is certified for 14 divers, runs Saturdays from Coral Bay Marina, and I skipper her myself. Book through me, Captain Rob Hale.
Our second charter option is the boat Dolphin Run, skippered by Ana Beltran, based at the same Coral Bay Marina.
June accounts are reconciled. Reminder that I am away the first week of July, so get any large orders to me before then.
Booked our regular Saturday reef trip on Marlin II with Captain Rob Hale for Saturday 7 November 2026, departing Coral Bay Marina at 09:00, since Marlin II runs Saturdays from the marina.
Happy to cover Open Water pool sessions again this season on Tuesday evenings if you need me, Marta.
Confirmed the Blue Reef Diving Club group trip with Dana Ruiz: 12 club divers on Marlin II for Saturday 7 November 2026. The boat's 14-diver certification covers 12 divers plus crew comfortably.
Great, the club is looking forward to 7 November. I will collect balances from our 12 divers in October.

Drafted the rental tank order with Bay Gas Supplies for the Blue Reef club trip on 7 November 2026: 14 tanks, that is 12 for the club divers plus 2 for staff, at 9 per tank per day from Luis Ferrer. Total 126, so no finance sign-off needed.
Compressor room filters arrived. I have shelved them next to the nitrox analyser.
Ordered a restock of 6 rental wetsuits from Seafit Gear for 540 in total, under the 800 finance sign-off threshold.
Autumn schedule note for your newsletter, Marta: Marlin II, certified for 14 divers, Saturdays from Coral Bay Marina as usual.
Booked the Tuesday evening Discover Scuba pool session at Coral Bay Leisure Pool for 3 November 2026 with Ana Beltran instructing.
Heads up: Dolphin Run is certified for 18 divers if you ever need a bigger boat for a club charter this autumn.
October card statements are in. Nothing unusual except the fuel bill from the marina.
We will be closed 12 to 14 October for stocktake, so send any tank orders early that week.

Marta, the surveyor has been aboard after the engine refit: Marlin II is now certified for 10 divers maximum. She still runs Saturdays from Coral Bay Marina with me skippering, same departure setup as ever.
Nitrox blend for the weekend group is done and logged. Cylinders are racked by the back door.
Assigned Ana Beltran to instruct the Open Water course classroom session at the dive centre on 5 November 2026.
Club balances for the 7 November trip are nearly all in. Let me know if you need anything else from me.
Ordered 4 compressor filters from AirPure Marine for 320 in total, under the 800 sign-off threshold.
Fuel dock access will be restricted on 30 October from 06:00 to 10:00 for maintenance.
Pay the Bay Gas Supplies September invoice by 30 October 2026.
Confirmed with the leisure pool for 3 November. They want us in by 18:30.
Your wetsuit restock has shipped and should reach the dive centre early next week.
